next.reason: 1985: 'If the REPLACING phrase is specified, the characters transmitted by the SEND statement replace all characters'; 2023: '2023 SEND (14.9.38) sends messages between run units and has no REPLACING phrase or character-imaging device rules'. The communication module and its device-oriented SEND are gone. The 2023 SEND is a message-server statement with no REPLACING or superimposing rules, and no candidate states them.
